briefdescription.para: Check if this expression starts with GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE and if it is of the form GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE-symbol.

detaileddescription.para: This is needed to support PIC on ELF i386 as GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE is magical. We check only simple case that are know to be used: GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE by itself or at the start of a binary expression.
